description: Get or redeem a premium skill or multi-fix bundle after choosing with list_skills. Call with the id alone to receive the free outline, dollar price, signed Base Pay USDC and exact-ETH offers, and one pay-and-redeem action. After payment, call once more with the matching paymentTx and private paymentOffer for the complete SKILL.md or assembled bundle decision tree, fix bodies, verification commands, update guidance, and sources. Do not use this for individual fixes; call get_fix instead. Never pay again merely because an existing proof is pending or denied.

id.description: Exact skill or bundle id from list_skills.

paymentOffer.description: Private signed bearer token from get_offer; never publish it.

paymentTx.description: Base Pay UserOperation hash for USDC or Base transaction hash for ETH.

name: get_skill

citation.description: KnownFix source attribution request returned with the purchased good.

checkout.description: Whether both signed payment rails were issued.

diagnosisPreview.description: Free diagnosis and triage for an individual paid fix.

nextAction.description: The single recommended payment or retry action.

payment.description: Preferred Base Pay parameters and signed exact-ETH alternative.

product.description: Free skill or bundle outline and product identity.

recommendation.description: Demand evidence and matched-fix context when a multi-fix pack is the recommended purchase.

signedPurchaseOffer.description: Private product-bound Base Pay USDC offer.

singleFixAlternative.description: Lower-cost individual-fix fallback when the recommended product is a bundle.

receipt.description: Machine-readable receipt derived by KnownFix after signed-offer and Base proof verification; never accepted from caller input.

skillMd.description: Full assembled Markdown. Bundles include their decision tree, included fix bodies, commands, verification guidance, and sources.

title: Redeem a premium skill or bundle
